text:
maria: Starting a small staged rollout: service-infer v2.3.1 -> canary 3% (eu-west). Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pin fallback to v2.3.0. @ops_jess monitor infra; deploy-bot will orchestrate traffic.

deploy-bot: [3301245000] ACTION: start-rollout; version=v2.3.1; target=3%; region=eu-west; autoscale=enabled; rollback-hook=pin:v2.3.0

kevin: I'll watch latency p95 and error rate. Flagging thresholds: p95 +50ms, errors >1%.

qa-lina: Running quick smoke tests against the canary subset. Will share results in ~7m.

ops_jess: Oncall here. Alerts configured for 5xx>0.5% or host mem>85%.

ryan: If we need emergency rollback, suggest immediate traffic pin plus scale-up of drainable instances to avoid coldstarts.

maria: Rollback criteria as discussed: sustained error_rate >1% (5m) OR p95 +50ms OR QA regression on eval set B.

deploy-bot: [3301245055] METRICS: canary=3%; error_rate=0.2%; p95_latency=+8ms; throughput=stable; kv_cache_miss=slight

kevin: Good baseline. KV cache warming expected.

qa-lina: Smoke ok so far, one minor mismatch in templated output, logging to QA board. Example:
```
INPUT: "List data retention steps"
CANARY OUTPUT: "No retention."  <-- missing detail
BASELINE OUTPUT: "Retention includes..."
```

maria: Minor QA note but not a blocking regression. Quick vote: ramp to 10% or hold?

kevin: :thumbsup: proceed but require 20m stable metrics.

ops_jess: :thumbsup: proceed.

ryan: :thumbsup: proceed with auto-rollback trigger if QA>3 fails in 15m.

maria: Proceeding to 10% in 10m. Deploy-bot schedule set.

deploy-bot: [3301245100] ACTION: schedule-ramp; from=3%; to=10%; start_in=10m; abort_conditions=[qa_failures>3, errors>1%_5m, p95>+50ms]; rollback_action=pin:v2.3.0

kevin: I'll post any alerts here.

qa-lina: Continuing tests. Will post additional examples to the QA board.

ops_jess: Standing by for pin execution if needed.

maria: Thanks, team. If no issues, we'll continue to 25% after another 45m. :rocket:
